usedFor: Farmbrite holds farm tasks, orders and harvests, and Slack receives them as posts through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Farmbrite, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new order is news for the team, and the message goes to a channel, user or thread.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval, so “Send Message” will not post until you approve.
